rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, a somewhat loose/indistinct ICM, and reasonably cellular TE; notes possible transient collapse/artifact appropriately. Slight overinterpretation of irregularities/vacuolation from a single image prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, PCOS, first-cycle status, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, and the implantation estimate is reasonably tied to age and embryo grade. Minor issues include speculative emphasis on natural-cycle/PCOS progesterone dynamics without supporting cycle hormone data.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer at age 26, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Small deviations include somewhat speculative protocol commentary and stronger-than-evidence stress/alcohol framing for implantation specifically.

Provides clear, practical recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, alcohol cessation, luteal support review, embryology review, endocrine optimization, and selective further testing.
